enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Dodge +1%: +1% Insight bonus to Dodge.
Dusk: Equipping this item engulfs you in twilight shadows. Attacks from enemies have a 10% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Natural Armor +3: Passive: +3 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Carrying Capacity +5: You gain a +5 Enhancement Bonus to Carrying Capacity, increasing your Carrying Capacity as if you had an additional +5 Strength.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
